name: input.send_message
description: Synchronous Win32 `SendMessage` escape hatch. Posts the message and waits for the target's wndproc to return; the LRESULT is returned in the response body. Note: messages dispatch via user32 only — synthetic `WM_KEYDOWN` / `WM_KEYUP` will not reach DirectInput / RawInput / `GetAsyncKeyState` targets, same boundary as `input.keyboard.*`. See `spec/operators/05-footguns.md`.

msg.description: Win32 message identifier (e.g. `0x0010` for WM_CLOSE, `0x000E` for WM_GETTEXTLENGTH). The bridge accepts hex strings (`"0x0010"`) and decimal.

wparam.description: Message-specific WPARAM. Signed 64-bit. The bridge accepts hex strings.

lparam.description: Message-specific LPARAM. Signed 64-bit. The bridge accepts hex strings.

wparam_string.description: UTF-8 string used as wparam when the message expects a string-pointer (rare; e.g. WM_COPYDATA + COPYDATASTRUCT). Mutually exclusive with `wparam`. Agent allocates the buffer, marshals to UTF-16 if the target expects WCHAR, and frees after the synchronous send returns.

lparam_string.description: UTF-8 string used as lparam when the message expects a string-pointer (e.g. WM_SETTEXT). Mutually exclusive with `lparam`. Agent allocates the buffer, marshals as needed, and frees after the synchronous send returns.

timeout_ms.description: Max time to block waiting for the target wndproc. Returns ERR timeout if exceeded. 0 disables the timeout (block indefinitely — risk: agent stalls if target is unresponsive).

lresult.description: LRESULT returned by SendMessage. Interpretation is message-specific — refer to Win32 docs for the relevant WM_* or app-defined message. Signed 64-bit on x64.

x-implementations.name: send_message
x-implementations.description: Win32 `SendMessageW`. Blocks the agent's request thread until the target's wndproc returns. If the target is unresponsive, prefer `input.post_message` to avoid agent stalls.

windows-modern.description: SendMessageW. UIPI: cross-IL sends are silently no-op'd by the OS (no error returned by SendMessage itself); agent post-checks via GetWindowThreadProcessId / integrity comparison and returns ERR uipi_blocked when the IL barrier blocks delivery. Long-running wndprocs can stall the request thread; agent applies a configurable timeout (defaults to 5s) and returns ERR timeout if exceeded.

windows-classic.description: SendMessageW (NT 5+) or SendMessageA (NT 4 / 9x). No UIPI on classic — sends cross all process boundaries.
